title.en: Reading Catch-22: restored English and five complete new editions
title.zh: 《第二十二条军规》：补全英文，新增五语全文
title.zh-hant: 《第二十二條軍規》：補全英文，新增五語全文

summary.en: Four essays restore the scenes and argument missing from the shorter English edition and add Japanese, French, German, Spanish and Korean. Chinese and Traditional Chinese remain available; Snowden's chapter reference is corrected.
summary.zh: 4 篇散文补回旧英文省去的场景与论证，新增日、法、德、西、韩全文；保留简繁中文，并订正斯诺登一幕的章节标记。
summary.zh-hant: 4 篇散文補回舊英文省去的場景與論證，新增日、法、德、西、韓全文；保留簡繁中文，並訂正斯諾登一幕的章節標記。
